name: Lemm/ing ~Ushinawareta Mura~
source:
I am Toochika Sora, and I'm a freelance writer.

We arrived in a strange village the name of which I don't know, after straying from the long mountain path. We were welcomed with a ritual slaughter. Can we get out of this village in one piece?

Can we escape from our prison!? 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE038112.html]DLsite English[/url]]
